subject.title: [Feature]: Add a visible browser panel to the Control UI for login handoff and browser management

question: What browser handoff surface should OpenClaw expose in the Control UI for managed login flows, and which operator scopes/redaction/write controls must gate it?
rationale: The source proves the gap, but the permanent UX and security boundary affects authenticated browser state and overlaps generic plugin UI infrastructure, so automation should not choose the product shape alone.

options.title: Define secured core handoff
options.body: Add a first-class Control UI browser handoff surface with explicit operator scopes, redaction rules, tab/profile context, and resume semantics.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI foundation
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until the related plugin Control UI entry-point direction lands or is rejected.

options.title: Keep CLI-only for now
options.body: Decline a Control UI panel and document CLI/browser-login workflows as the supported handoff path, accepting the UX friction.

recommendation.title: Define secured core handoff
recommendation.body: Add a first-class Control UI browser handoff surface with explicit operator scopes, redaction rules, tab/profile context, and resume semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the canonical acceptance criteria in the issue discussion and have recent reachable Control UI/browser-adjacent history.
